sourceNote: Sepehran FCOM and B737 MRG IV.15. This is a system contract, not licensed audio media.

phrases.when: Valid engine/APU/wheel-well/installed-cargo fire detector discrete
phrases.repeat: bell while active, not one per sensor
phrases.stop: FIRE WARN/BELL CUTOUT or warning clears

phrases.when: Cabin altitude >10,000 ft OR on-ground takeoff-thrust + invalid flap/LE/speedbrake/parking brake/stabilizer trim
phrases.repeat: shared intermittent horn; one voice even if both inputs active
phrases.stop: Cabin ALT HORN CUTOUT for cabin source, or clear underlying takeoff-config condition

phrases.when: Gear not down locked + flap/thrust/RA based landing-configuration logic (FCOM Classic variant)
phrases.repeat: steady horn while eligible
phrases.stop: gear/config safe or gear horn cutout when permitted

phrases.when: IAS>configured VMO or Mach>configured MMO
phrases.repeat: repeat clacker while beyond limit

phrases.when: Stall warning computer output in flight, or valid ground stall warning test
phrases.repeat: continuous mechanical vibration

phrases.when: A/P engaged -> disengaged
phrases.repeat: wailer at least 2 seconds and until acknowledged
phrases.stop: A/P warning reset after minimum duration

phrases.when: MCP-altitude acquisition within 900 ft or deviation >300 ft after capture; inhibit at flaps>=25 or G/S capture
phrases.repeat: single momentary tone per event

phrases.when: Trim actuator physically moves
phrases.repeat: mechanical noise while moving

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 2500 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 1000 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 500 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 100 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 50 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 40 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 30 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 20 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: Valid EGPWS and Radio Altimeter approach descent crosses 10 ft RA
phrases.repeat: single callout per descent crossing; rearm on new approach

phrases.when: RA descending across Capt minimums + 80 ft
phrases.repeat: single announcement

phrases.when: RA descending across Capt minimums + 0 ft
phrases.repeat: single announcement

phrases.when: PULL UP severity output from validated EGPWS Mode 1/2/look-ahead detector
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: validated EGPWS Mode 1 excessive descent-rate caution
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: validated EGPWS terrain-closure warning
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: valid forward-looking terrain warning
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: valid forward-looking terrain caution
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: EGPWS Mode 3 excessive post-takeoff/go-around altitude loss
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: EGPWS Mode 4 unsafe low terrain clearance with gear not down
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: EGPWS Mode 4 unsafe low terrain clearance with landing flaps not set
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: EGPWS Mode 4 unsafe terrain clearance at high speed/outside landing config
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: EGPWS Mode 5 excessive deviation below glide slope, subject to installed G/S inhibit
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: reactive GPWS windshear warning computer output, valid takeoff/approach/landing
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: predictive weather-radar windshear warning from detector with phase inhibits
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: installed predictive windshear warning during approach, below 1200 ft RA
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: EGPWS bank angle crosses 35/40/45 deg, rearmed only at <=30 deg
phrases.repeat: one per bank threshold

phrases.when: forward-looking obstacle caution, if installed
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: forward-looking obstacle warning, if installed
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: terrain-clearance-floor caution where installed phrase matches
phrases.repeat: repeat on EGPWS-provided phrase pulses; do not guess fixed warning cadence

phrases.when: New Traffic Advisory output from TCAS TA logic; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override
phrases.repeat: once per TCAS source event

phrases.when: TCAS resolution advisory commands climb; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override
phrases.repeat: once per TCAS source event

phrases.when: TCAS RA commands descent; <1100 ft inhibitions apply; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override
phrases.repeat: once per TCAS source event

phrases.when: TCAS stronger climb RA; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override
phrases.repeat: once per TCAS source event

phrases.when: TCAS stronger descent RA; <1500 ft inhibit; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override
phrases.repeat: once per TCAS source event

phrases.when: Installed TCAS selected-phrase RA; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override

phrases.when: Installed TCAS selected-phrase RA; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override

phrases.when: TCAS reports conflict resolved; TCAS voice inhibited below approx 500 ft RA; GPWS/windshear warnings override
